description: Real Stremio stream responses captured from public add-ons with no account or debrid key: Torrentio (movie and series episode), TorrentsDB (movie), Peerflix (movie and series episode) and Jackettio (an add-on that is not configured). Only the descriptive text is kept: name, title, description and behaviorHints.filename. infoHash, url, tracker and source arrays, binge groups and provider hosts are removed, and the site named after ⚙️/🌐 and inside Peerflix filenames is replaced by 'Site' and 'release'. candidate is the SourceCandidate the engine serves for that stream (detail is the stream's own lines joined with newlines, the rest are the normalized release facts), expect is what the row must show.
